name: VA-10
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by 6 points on the PVI
Subramanyam has a large fundraising edge ($1.17M vs $107K)
Prediction markets price Democratic win at 94-96%
First-term incumbent with no polling or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Subramanyam: a D+6 district, incumbency, and a roughly 10-to-1 fundraising advantage, while both Kalshi and Polymarket price his win above 94%. With no polls or expert ratings to contradict that picture, the forecast stays near the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending for Beckwith or an unusually favorable Republican national environment could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Northern Virginia's 10th District leans Democratic, and first-term incumbent Suhas Subramanyam is seeking reelection after winning the open seat in 2024. He faces Republican Dave Beckwith, who has raised just over $107,000, plus a minor independent candidate. Subramanyam has raised about $1.17 million and holds a large cash advantage, with modest outside support on his side and none opposing him.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and money. Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both price Subramanyam as a heavy favorite, above 94%. The forecast calls the race Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty coming from the absence of polling rather than any specific contrary evidence.
